Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 601–700

Turkish words 601 to 700, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 62 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 601
    değernoun

    value, worth

    Bu tablonun değeri ne kadar?

    How much is this painting worth?

    Değerli = valuable. Not the same as değer from değmek (to be worth it): Buna değer = It's worth it.

    A2

  2. 602
    uğraşmakverb

    to deal with, to work on; to bother, to mess with (-lA); to struggle

    Bütün gün bu işle uğraştım.

    I spent all day dealing with this job.

    aorist uğraşır · present uğraşıyor · past uğraştı · future uğraşacak

    Takes -lA: bu işle uğraşmak. Benimle uğraşma! = Don't mess with me! The noun uğraş is an effort or a pastime.

    B1

  3. 603
    hediyenoun

    present, gift

    Annem için güzel bir hediye aldım.

    I bought a nice present for my mom.

    Hediye etmek = to give as a present; doğum günü hediyesi = birthday present.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  4. 604
    sınıfnoun

    classroom; class (of students); grade, year; class, category

    Sınıfta yirmi öğrenci var.

    There are twenty students in the class.

    Kaçıncı sınıftasın? = What grade are you in? Also a category: birinci sınıf = first-class.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  5. 605
    kusurnoun

    fault, flaw; defect

    Kusura bakma, geç kaldım.

    Sorry I'm late.

    Kusura bakma (polite: Kusura bakmayın) = Sorry, excuse me; literally, don't look at the fault. Kusursuz = flawless.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  6. 606
    saldırınoun

    attack

    Saldırıdan sonra herkes çok korktu.

    Everyone was very scared after the attack.

    From saldırmak (to attack). A heart attack is kalp krizi, not saldırı.

    B1

  7. 607
    şöyleadverb

    like this, this way; as follows; so-so (şöyle böyle)

    Şöyle yapalım: önce yiyelim, sonra gidelim.

    Let's do it like this: first we eat, then we go.

    Şöyle points to what comes next, böyle to what is here, öyle to what was said. Şöyle böyle = so-so.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  8. 608
    kaptannoun

    captain (of a ship, a plane, a team)

    Takımımızın kaptanı Emre.

    Our team's captain is Emre.

    The t doesn't soften: kaptanı. Of a ship, a plane or a team; the pilot in command of an airliner is the kaptan pilot.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

  9. 609
    topnoun

    ball

    Çocuklar bahçede top oynuyor.

    The children are playing ball in the garden.

    Top oynamak = to play ball; futbol topu = soccer ball. Not to be confused with toplamak (to collect).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 8: Small words: dA, bile, ki, ya

  10. 610
    rüyanoun

    dream (while asleep)

    Dün gece garip bir rüya gördüm.

    I had a strange dream last night.

    Rüya görmek = to dream, literally to see a dream: Rüyamda seni gördüm. A wish or ambition is hayal.

    A2

  11. 611
    sessizadjective

    quiet, silent

    Burası çok sessiz bir mahalle.

    This is a very quiet neighbourhood.

    Ses (sound, voice) + -sIz (without). Sessiz ol! = Be quiet! Sessizce = quietly.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  12. 612
    inmekverb

    to get off, to get out (of a vehicle); to go down, to come down; to land

    Bir sonraki durakta iniyoruz.

    We're getting off at the next stop.

    aorist iner · present iniyor · past indi · future inecek

    What you get off or come down takes the ablative: otobüsten inmek, merdivenden inmek. A plane iner (lands). The opposite is binmek.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  13. 613
    yakındaadverb

    soon; nearby

    Yakında görüşürüz!

    See you soon!

    The locative of yakın (near), so also nearby: yakında bir eczane (a pharmacy nearby). With the future: Yakında döneceğim.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  14. 614
    dalganoun

    wave

    Bugün denizde büyük dalgalar var.

    There are big waves on the sea today.

    Dalga geçmek (colloquial) = to make fun of, to fool around: Benimle dalga mı geçiyorsun? = Are you kidding me?

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  15. 615
    hapisnoun

    prison, jail; imprisonment

    Hırsız üç yıl hapis yattı.

    The thief spent three years in prison.

    accusative hapsi

    The i drops before a vowel: hapse girmek (to go to prison), but hapisten çıkmak. Hapis yatmak = to serve time. The building is hapishane or cezaevi.

    B1

  16. 616
    varmakverb

    to arrive, to reach

    Saat kaçta Ankara'ya varırız?

    What time will we get to Ankara?

    aorist varır · present varıyor · past vardı · future varacak

    One of the 13 verbs with the aorist -Ir: varır. The place takes the dative: eve varmak. Not to be confused with var (there is).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

  17. 617
    yalnızcaadverb

    only, just

    Yalnızca beş dakika bekledim.

    I only waited five minutes.

    A little more formal than sadece. Yalnız also means only, as well as alone and but.

    B1

  18. 618
    ilaçnoun

    medicine, medication; drug (medical)

    Bu ilacı günde iki kez iç.

    Take this medicine twice a day.

    accusative ilacı

    The ç becomes c before a vowel: ilacı. Medicine is taken with içmek or almak. Böcek ilacı = insecticide; illegal drugs are uyuşturucu.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need

  19. 619
    kısımnoun

    part, section

    Bu kısım çok önemli, dikkatli okuyun.

    This part is very important, read it carefully.

    accusative kısmı

    The ı drops before a vowel: kısmı, kısmen (partly). Bölüm is a chapter or an episode.

    B1

  20. 620
    çantanoun

    bag, handbag

    Çantamı otobüste unuttum.

    I left my bag on the bus.

    Okul çantası = school bag, el çantası = handbag, sırt çantası = backpack.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  21. 621
    uçmakverb

    to fly

    Kuşlar kışın güneye uçar.

    Birds fly south in winter.

    aorist uçar · present uçuyor · past uçtu · future uçacak

    Planes and birds uçar; people usually uçakla gider (go by plane). Uçak (plane) and uçuş (flight) come from it.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  22. 622
    yemin etmekverb

    to swear, to take an oath

    Yemin ederim, ben bir şey yapmadım!

    I swear, I didn't do anything!

    aorist yemin eder · present yemin ediyor · past yemin etti · future yemin edecek

    Yemin ederim! = I swear! The noun is yemin (oath). Swearing in the sense of cursing is küfür etmek.

    B1

  23. 623
    ifadenoun

    expression; statement (to the police), testimony; wording

    Yüzündeki ifadeyi gördün mü?

    Did you see the expression on his face?

    İfade etmek = to express; ifade vermek = to give a statement. Yüz ifadesi = facial expression.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 7: Discourse and argument

  24. 624
    deniznoun

    sea

    Yazın her gün denize giriyoruz.

    In summer we go swimming in the sea every day.

    Denize girmek = to go swimming in the sea; deniz kenarı = seaside. Karadeniz = the Black Sea, Akdeniz = the Mediterranean.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  25. 625
    kartnoun

    card

    Kartla ödeyebilir miyim?

    Can I pay by card?

    A bank card, a greeting card or a game card: kredi kartı (credit card), doğum günü kartı. A business card is a kartvizit.

    A2

  26. 626
    vücutnoun

    body

    Spor vücuda iyi gelir.

    Exercise is good for the body.

    accusative vücudu

    The t becomes d before a vowel: vücudu. A living body; a dead one is ceset. Beden is a synonym, and also a clothing size.

    A2

  27. 627
    cehennemnoun

    hell

    Bu sıcak cehennem gibi!

    This heat is like hell!

    The opposite is cennet (paradise, heaven). Cehenneme git! = Go to hell! (rude).

    B1

  28. 628
    yaşamnoun

    life

    Şehirde yaşam çok pahalı.

    Life in the city is very expensive.

    From yaşamak (to live). Hayat is more common in speech; yaşam is preferred in compounds such as yaşam tarzı (lifestyle).

    B1

  29. 629
    uğramakverb

    to drop by, to stop by; to suffer, to undergo (an attack, a loss)

    Akşam size uğrarım.

    I'll drop by your place this evening.

    aorist uğrar · present uğruyor · past uğradı · future uğrayacak

    The place takes the dative: markete uğramak. The a becomes u before -(I)yor: uğruyor. Also saldırıya uğramak = to be attacked.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 11: While and then

  30. 630
    umurnoun

    concern, care (umurumda değil: I don't care)

    Para umurumda değil.

    I don't care about money.

    Almost only with a possessive and değil or a question: umurumda değil (I don't care), Umurunda mı? (Does he care?). The thing cared about is the subject. Colloquial.

    B1

  31. 631
    kanıtnoun

    evidence, proof

    Elimizde hiç kanıt yok.

    We have no evidence.

    The t doesn't soften: kanıtı. Kanıtlamak = to prove. Delil is a more formal synonym.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 3: Although, despite, without

  32. 632
    programnoun

    plan, schedule; program, show (on TV); program (software)

    Bu akşam programın var mı?

    Do you have plans this evening?

    Programın var mı? = Are you free? Do you have plans? Program yapmak = to make plans.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  33. 633
    beğenmekverb

    to like (something seen or tried); to approve of

    Filmi beğendin mi?

    Did you like the movie?

    aorist beğenir · present beğeniyor · past beğendi · future beğenecek

    For things you see, try or taste, with the accusative: Elbiseyi beğendim. Sevmek is for lasting likes and for love.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 6: Object participles

  34. 634
    kutunoun

    box; can, tin

    Bu kutuda ne var?

    What's in this box?

    Also a can: bir kutu kola. Posta kutusu = mailbox.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  35. 635
    yaratmakverb

    to create

    Bu karar büyük bir sorun yarattı.

    This decision created a big problem.

    aorist yaratır · present yaratıyor · past yarattı · future yaratacak

    Yaratıcı = creative; yaratık = creature. Making something with your hands is yapmak.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 7: Stacked voices

  36. 636
    doğumnoun

    birth

    Doğum tarihiniz nedir?

    What is your date of birth?

    From doğmak (to be born). Doğum günü = birthday; doğum yeri = place of birth.

    A2

  37. 637
    dairpostposition

    about, concerning, on

    Bu konuya dair hiçbir bilgim yok.

    I have no information about this matter.

    After the dative, and rather formal: buna dair. Speech uses hakkında or ile ilgili. Not to be confused with daire (apartment).

    B1

  38. 638
    şanslıadjective

    lucky

    Bugün şanslı günüm!

    Today is my lucky day!

    Şans (luck) + -lI. The opposite is şanssız (unlucky).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  39. 639
    halknoun

    the people, the public; folk

    Bu müze halka açık mı?

    Is this museum open to the public?

    Halk müziği = folk music, halk dansları = folk dances. Halka açık = open to the public.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  40. 640
    sırnoun

    secret

    Bu bir sır, kimseye söyleme!

    It's a secret, don't tell anyone!

    accusative sırrı

    The r doubles before a vowel: sırrı, sırrım. Sır tutmak = to keep a secret; gizli = secret (adjective).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 4: Noun clauses

  41. 641
    balıknoun

    fish

    Akşam balık yiyelim mi?

    Shall we have fish tonight?

    accusative balığı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: balığı. Balık tutmak = to fish; balıkçı = fisherman or fish restaurant.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

  42. 642
    sıcakadjective

    hot, warm

    Bugün hava çok sıcak.

    It's very hot today.

    For the weather, food, drinks and people (sıcak bir insan, a warm person). For I'm hot, say Sıcakladım.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  43. 643
    parknoun

    park

    Evin yakınında güzel bir park var.

    There's a nice park near the house.

    Also parking: park etmek (to park), otopark (parking lot), Park yapılmaz (no parking).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  44. 644
    düşmannoun

    enemy

    Eskiden düşmandık, şimdi en iyi arkadaşız.

    We used to be enemies, now we're best friends.

    Düşmanlık = hostility. A rival in sports or business is rakip.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

  45. 645
    bağlamakverb

    to tie, to tie up; to connect, to link; to put through (on the phone)

    Köpeği ağaca bağladı.

    He tied the dog to the tree.

    aorist bağlar · present bağlıyor · past bağladı · future bağlayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: bağlıyor. On the phone: Sizi müdüre bağlıyorum (I'm putting you through to the manager). Bağlı = tied; connected.

    B1

  46. 646
    listenoun

    list

    Alışveriş listesini evde unuttum.

    I left the shopping list at home.

    Alışveriş listesi = shopping list; bekleme listesi = waiting list.

    A2

  47. 647
    mektupnoun

    letter (that you write)

    Anneme uzun bir mektup yazdım.

    I wrote a long letter to my mom.

    accusative mektubu

    The p becomes b before a vowel: mektubu. A letter of the alphabet is harf.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous

  48. 648
    ayarlamakverb

    to arrange, to set up; to set, to adjust

    Sana bir randevu ayarladım.

    I set up an appointment for you.

    aorist ayarlar · present ayarlıyor · past ayarladı · future ayarlayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: ayarlıyor. From ayar (setting): saati ayarlamak = to set a clock.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 7: Stacked voices

  49. 649
    temizadjective

    clean

    Bardaklar temiz mi?

    Are the glasses clean?

    Temizlemek = to clean; tertemiz = spotlessly clean; temiz hava = fresh air.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  50. 650
    testnoun

    test (medical); quiz, multiple-choice test

    Doktor kan testi istedi.

    The doctor asked for a blood test.

    A medical test (kan testi, hamilelik testi) or a multiple-choice test; a school exam is usually sınav.

    A2

  51. 651
    beyinnoun

    brain

    Uyku beyin için çok önemli.

    Sleep is very important for the brain.

    accusative beyni

    The i drops before a vowel: beyni. Beyin fırtınası = brainstorming. The mind is akıl.

    B1

  52. 652
    pardoninterjection

    excuse me, sorry; Pardon? (asking someone to repeat)

    Pardon, istasyon nerede?

    Excuse me, where's the station?

    From French. For getting attention or a small apology; a real apology is özür dilerim. Pardon? also asks someone to repeat.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 1: Letters and sounds

  53. 653
    tehlikenoun

    danger

    Tehlike geçti, artık çıkabiliriz.

    The danger is over, we can come out now.

    Tehlikeli = dangerous; tehlikede = in danger.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 3: Complex nominalizations

  54. 654
    suçluadjective

    guilty; criminal, culprit (noun)

    Bence o adam suçlu değil.

    I don't think that man is guilty.

    Suç (crime, fault) + -lI. The opposite is suçsuz or masum (innocent). Kendini suçlu hissetmek = to feel guilty.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  55. 655
    senenoun

    year

    İki sene önce buraya taşındık.

    We moved here two years ago.

    Means the same as yıl, and is a little more colloquial. Seneye = next year, geçen sene = last year.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 3: The future

  56. 656
    keşkeadverb

    I wish, if only

    Keşke sen de gelsen.

    I wish you'd come too.

    With the conditional -sA for a wish (Keşke gelsen), with -sAydI for a regret (Keşke gelseydin: I wish you had come).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 1: Unreal conditionals and wishes

  57. 657
    uymakverb

    to suit, to fit, to match; to follow, to obey (rules)

    Yarın saat beş sana uyar mı?

    Does five o'clock tomorrow suit you?

    aorist uyar · present uyuyor · past uydu · future uyacak

    What is suited or obeyed takes the dative: kurallara uymak (to follow the rules). Uyuyor is also the present of uyumak (to sleep).

    B1

  58. 658
    tehlikeliadjective

    dangerous

    Bu yol gece çok tehlikeli.

    This road is very dangerous at night.

    Tehlike (danger) + -lI. The opposite is güvenli (safe).

    A2

  59. 659
    otelnoun

    hotel

    Otelimiz denize çok yakın.

    Our hotel is very close to the sea.

    Otelde kalmak = to stay at a hotel. A small family hotel is a pansiyon.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  60. 660
    harcamakverb

    to spend (money); to use up, to waste

    Bu ay çok para harcadım.

    I spent a lot of money this month.

    aorist harcar · present harcıyor · past harcadı · future harcayacak

    The a becomes ı before -(I)yor: harcıyor. Spending time is usually geçirmek; vakit harcamak = to waste time.

    A2

  61. 661
    takılmakverb

    to get caught, to get stuck; to hang out (colloquial); to tease (dative)

    Trafiğe takıldım, biraz geç kalacağım.

    I'm stuck in traffic, I'll be a bit late.

    aorist takılır · present takılıyor · past takıldı · future takılacak

    The passive of takmak (to attach, to put on). Bana takılma! = Stop teasing me! In casual speech, takılmak is also to hang out.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs

  62. 662
    karanlıknoun

    darkness, the dark; dark (adjective)

    Karanlıkta hiçbir şey göremiyorum.

    I can't see anything in the dark.

    accusative karanlığı

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: karanlığı. Also an adjective: karanlık bir oda. Hava karardı = it got dark.

    A2

  63. 663
    inanılmazadjective

    unbelievable, incredible; incredibly (before an adjective)

    Manzara inanılmaz güzeldi!

    The view was incredibly beautiful!

    Literally that can't be believed, from inanmak. Often an intensifier: inanılmaz güzel.

    A2

  64. 664
    basitadjective

    simple, easy; plain; cheap, common (of a person)

    Bu çok basit bir soru.

    This is a very simple question.

    Also easy: basit bir iş. Said of a person or an act, basit is a put-down: cheap, petty.

    A2

  65. 665
    fırsatnoun

    opportunity, chance

    Bu fırsatı kaçırma!

    Don't miss this opportunity!

    Fırsat bulmak = to find the time or the chance; fırsat bu fırsat = while we have the chance. Luck is şans.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  66. 666
    kasabanoun

    small town

    Küçük bir kasabada büyüdüm.

    I grew up in a small town.

    Bigger than a köy (village), smaller than a şehir (city). Not to be confused with kasap (butcher).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 12: Reported speech

  67. 667
    derecenoun

    degree (of temperature, of an angle); level, extent; place, ranking (in a contest)

    Bugün hava otuz derece.

    It's thirty degrees today.

    Sıfırın altında beş derece = five below zero. Dereceye girmek = to place in a race or an exam.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  68. 668
    eğlenceliadjective

    fun, entertaining

    Parti çok eğlenceliydi.

    The party was a lot of fun.

    Eğlence (fun, entertainment) + -lI; eğlenmek = to have fun. The opposite is sıkıcı (boring).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns

  69. 669
    muhteşemadjective

    magnificent, wonderful; gorgeous

    Yemek muhteşemdi, elinize sağlık!

    The meal was wonderful, thank you!

    Stronger than güzel or harika: muhteşem bir manzara (a magnificent view).

    A2

  70. 670
    dedektifnoun

    detective

    Dedektif sonunda katili buldu.

    The detective finally found the killer.

    Common in novels and films; the police officer in charge of a case is usually a komiser.

    B1

  71. 671
    uyuşturucunoun

    drug, drugs (illegal)

    Polis arabada uyuşturucu buldu.

    The police found drugs in the car.

    From uyuşturmak (to numb). Only illegal drugs; medicine is ilaç.

    B1

  72. 672
    çıkartmakverb

    to take off, to take out; to remove

    Ayakkabılarını çıkart, lütfen.

    Take your shoes off, please.

    aorist çıkartır · present çıkartıyor · past çıkarttı · future çıkartacak

    Used like çıkarmak, which is the more standard form and the one the lessons teach. Çıkartma = sticker.

    A2

  73. 673
    yeterliadjective

    enough, sufficient

    Bu para yeterli değil.

    This money isn't enough.

    From yetmek (to be enough): Yeter! = Enough! Stop it! Yeterince = enough (adverb).

    A2

  74. 674
    kameranoun

    camera (video, security)

    Bu sokakta her yerde kamera var.

    There are cameras everywhere on this street.

    Usually a video or security camera; a camera for photos is a fotoğraf makinesi.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  75. 675
    iyiliknoun

    favour; kindness, goodness

    Bana bir iyilik yapar mısın?

    Can you do me a favour?

    accusative iyiliği

    The k becomes ğ before a vowel: iyiliği. İyilik yapmak = to do a favour. İyilik sağlık = all good (a casual reply to Nasılsın?).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  76. 676
    binanoun

    building

    Bu bina çok eski.

    This building is very old.

    Any building; a block of flats is an apartman. Binanın kapısı = the building's door.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?

  77. 677
    toplantınoun

    meeting

    Toplantı saat üçte başlıyor.

    The meeting starts at three.

    From toplanmak (to gather). Toplantıdayım = I'm in a meeting.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  78. 678
    gülmekverb

    to laugh; to smile

    Neden gülüyorsun?

    Why are you laughing?

    aorist güler · present gülüyor · past güldü · future gülecek

    What you laugh at takes the dative: Bana gülme! (Don't laugh at me!). Gülümsemek means only to smile.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without

  79. 679
    güneşnoun

    sun

    Güneş saat yedide doğuyor.

    The sun rises at seven.

    Güneş doğuyor = the sun is rising, güneş batıyor = it's setting. Güneş gözlüğü = sunglasses; güneşli = sunny.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  80. 680
    öğretmekverb

    to teach

    Bana Türkçe öğretir misin?

    Will you teach me Turkish?

    aorist öğretir · present öğretiyor · past öğretti · future öğretecek

    The learner takes the dative: Çocuklara matematik öğretiyor. From öğrenmek (to learn); öğretmen = teacher.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 7: Stacked voices

  81. 681
    kavganoun

    fight, quarrel

    Komşular yine kavga ediyor.

    The neighbours are fighting again.

    Kavga etmek = to fight, to quarrel (with: -lA). A war is savaş; an argument is also a tartışma.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  82. 682
    rapornoun

    report; doctor's note, sick note

    Raporu yarına kadar bitirmem lazım.

    I have to finish the report by tomorrow.

    Also a doctor's note for sick leave: rapor almak, raporlu olmak (to be on sick leave).

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 1: Stacked modality

  83. 683
    amcanoun

    uncle (father's brother); mister (to an older man)

    Amcam İzmir'de yaşıyor.

    My uncle lives in Izmir.

    The mother's brother is dayı. Children and young people call any older man amca: Amca, saat kaç?

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 9: My family

  84. 684
    saçmalıknoun

    nonsense

    Bu ne saçmalık!

    What nonsense!

    accusative saçmalığı

    From saçma (absurd). Saçmalama! = Don't talk nonsense! Colloquial.

    B1

  85. 685
    sonsuzadjective

    endless, infinite; eternal; forever (sonsuza kadar)

    Seni sonsuza kadar seveceğim.

    I'll love you forever.

    Son (end) + -sIz (without). Sonsuza kadar = forever.

    B1

  86. 686
    dekpostposition

    until, up to

    Sabaha dek çalıştık.

    We worked until morning.

    After the dative, like kadar: akşama dek. Mostly written or formal; speech uses kadar.

    B1

  87. 687
    üzülmekverb

    to be sad, to be upset; to be sorry (about)

    Buna çok üzüldüm.

    I'm very sorry about this.

    aorist üzülür · present üzülüyor · past üzüldü · future üzülecek

    The cause takes the dative: Buna üzüldüm. Üzülme! = Don't be sad, never mind. From üzmek (to upset).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns

  88. 688
    öğlenoun

    noon, midday

    Öğle yemeğinde ne yiyelim?

    What shall we have for lunch?

    Öğle yemeği = lunch; öğleden sonra = afternoon. Öğlen (noon; at noon) is the everyday form.

    A2

  89. 689
    belanoun

    trouble; nuisance, pest

    Başımız belada!

    We're in trouble!

    Başı belada = in trouble; bela çıkarmak = to make trouble; belalı = troublesome; troublemaker.

    B1

  90. 690
    herhâldeadverb

    probably, I guess

    Herhâlde yarın yağmur yağacak.

    It'll probably rain tomorrow.

    One word, with â (TDK). Galiba and muhtemelen are close in meaning.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

    ordunoun

    army

    Osmanlı ordusu çok büyüktü.

    The Ottoman army was very large.

    A soldier is asker, military service askerlik. Ordu is also a city on the Black Sea.

    C1First taught in C1 · Unit 2: -DIr: assumption and authority

    seriously, really

    Cidden mi? = Seriously? From ciddi (serious); close to gerçekten.

  93. 693
    şefnoun

    Bu lokantanın şefi çok ünlü.

    The chef of this restaurant is very famous.

    A head cook or a boss: şefim (my boss). An ordinary cook is an aşçı.

    A2

  94. 694

    Yarın mahkemeye gitmem lazım.

    Mahkemeye vermek = to take to court. The judge is hâkim or yargıç; the case is a dava.

    B1

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
